definitions.gloss: drafting; drawing up; preparing a proposal or plan
definitions.explanation: The act of creating a draft of a plan, proposal, bill, or official document. Commonly used in business and government contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{起案|きあん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To draft a new project proposal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{起案|きあん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}→承認：03237_shounin⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The plan drafted by the department head was approved.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{起案|きあん}⟦にあたって→にあたって：22936_niatatte⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦{省庁|しょうちょう}→省庁：13703_shouchou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不可欠|ふかけつ}→不可欠：07027_fukaketsu⟧だ。
examples.english: When drafting a bill, coordination with the relevant ministries is essential.

notes:
Composed of {起|き} (to start, to originate) and ⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧ (plan, proposal). The word emphasizes the initial creation of a plan or document, before it is reviewed or approved.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{起案|きあん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to draft a project proposal)
- ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{起案|きあん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to draft a bill)
- {起案|きあん}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (drafter, originator)
- {起案|きあん}⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (draft proposal document)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {起案|きあん}: to draft, to draw up (formal, initial creation of a plan)
- ⟦{立案|りつあん}→立案：15603_ritsuan⟧: to formulate a plan (broader, emphasizes planning process)
- ⟦{草案|そうあん}→草案：15762_souan⟧: draft, preliminary version (the document itself, not the act)
